railway_egress_policy: NOT_VERIFIED. No deployment network policy was tested. Application refusal is not that policy.

encryption.in_transit: PLANNED for a deployed HTTPS host. Not verified on a production terminator in this session.
encryption.at_rest: OPTIONAL_SERVER_KEY. AES-GCM from the cryptography library wraps the report blob when AUREX_DISPATER_DATA_KEYS holds an active 32-byte key. An empty object is NOT_CONFIGURED. Finding columns, source refs, and monitor payloads stay plaintext. The process that holds the key can decrypt. Backups are not encrypted by this code.
encryption.key_rotation: A new key id can be added and selected. Old report envelopes open only while their key remains configured.
encryption.key_revocation: Removing a data key makes those envelopes fail closed. Anchor kids listed as revoked do not verify.
encryption.tenant_key_boundary: NOT_IMPLEMENTED. One server key covers every tenant.
encryption.recovery_after_key_loss: FAIL_CLOSED. Lost key material is not recoverable from the ciphertext.
encryption.secret_logs: Error logs record the operation and the exception type. Tests reject a secret path in the response body.

egress.application: connector_destination_allowed denies a host that is not loopback and not listed in AUREX_EGRESS_ALLOWLIST. Financial transmission always raises FINANCIAL_EGRESS_PROHIBITED. WebsiteAdapter checks the pinned base URL before POST or GET.
egress.loopback_residual: Any loopback port is allowed for the local-inference shape. An allowlisted host is not restricted to https or to one port.

administration.cross_tenant_read_and_export: IMPLEMENTED. Wrong tenant is 403. Another tenant's run id is 404.
administration.plaintext_database_access: A process that can read the SQLite file can read finding columns and, when no data key is set, the report JSON.

lifecycle.customer_export: IMPLEMENTED for the tenant bearer. third_party_release false. Cache-Control no-store.
lifecycle.retention_request: RECORDED_NOT_ENFORCED. POST /v1/dispater/lifecycle/retention returns HOLD and does not delete.
lifecycle.deletion_request: RECORDED_NOT_EXECUTED. POST /v1/dispater/lifecycle/deletion-request does not remove runs.
lifecycle.deletion_confirmation: The response carries request_id, effect NONE, and reason DELETION_REQUIRES_SEPARATE_AUTHORIZATION.
lifecycle.audit_record_retention: NOT_IMPLEMENTED. purge_tenant remains a local maintenance function, not a customer API.
